title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（片桐由希子研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Katagiri Yukiko)
educationalGoal:
Students will:
1)learn how to accomplish all of the processes of a project arranged by themselves.
2) understand the methods of field surveys, investigation, analysis based on actual social conditions as a background.
3) Learn basic skill required to analyze changes in society and create a desirable environment and promote sustainability
advice:
This is a project that relates to landscape planning and Engineering.
Students design project themes by themselves, and solve the problem they have identified.
A total of 450 hours or more of study are required.
requiredKnowledge: Environmental Engineering I, Urban Design, Urban Planning and Local Development

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Students can fully explain their project and social subject.
(2) Students can fully perform field survey and analyses and investigations by themselves.
(3) Students can present and report their results and discuss them freely and fully.
(4) Students act in full accordance with engineering ethics.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Students can explain their project and social subject.
(2) Students can perform field survey and analyses.
(3) Students can present and report their results and discuss them.
(4) Students act in accordance with engineering ethics.

lessons.content:
1) Students identify their research topics.
2) Students conduct literature surveys.
3) Undergraduate students receive advice on
their research in seminars.
4) Presentations and papers are contributed
to academic societies.

1) Research activities continue.
2) A master's thesis is written, presented,
and defended in an open hearing.
